title: Ассоциативные правила
semantics: Association rules on one prepared table of discrete string transaction IDs and items, input 0 only. Set transaction_field, item_field, min_support_pct, min_confidence_pct and max_items; percentages are 0..100, thresholds inclusive. Execute explicitly trains current input then executes; existing omitted settings are preserved, repeated Execute retrains. Fixed: min lift 0, singletons included, native consequence limit 1. Read BOTH ports [0,1]: frequent itemsets and rules. Output Support and Confidence are fractions 0..1; padding is NULL, not empty text. Recommendation port 2, auxiliary input, saved-model holdout apply and other filters are deferred. Save the package separately.
